components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single primary action per view. Bright plasma fill, dark foreground for AA contrast.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: rgb(26 127 255); color: rgb(5 5 14); font-family: 'Syne', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; padding: 0 16px; height: 40px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 0.25rem; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1), transform 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1), box-shadow 150ms; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: rgb(0 98 230); box-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(26, 127, 255, 0.2); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgb(5 5 14), 0 0 0 4px rgb(26 127 255); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.4; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Quiet secondary action; fills with the accent surface on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { background: transparent; color: rgb(224 224 229); font-family: 'Syne', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; padding: 0 16px; height: 40px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 0.25rem; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1), color 150ms; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: rgb(37 37 53); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgb(5 5 14), 0 0 0 4px rgb(26 127 255); } .ds-btn-ghost:active { transform: scale(0.97); }

components.name: Destructive Button
components.description: Irreversible actions (kill session, unbind, delete). Crimson fill, dark foreground.
components.css: .ds-btn-destructive { background: rgb(244 63 94); color: rgb(5 5 14); font-family: 'Syne', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; padding: 0 16px; height: 40px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 0.25rem; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1), box-shadow 150ms, transform 150ms; } .ds-btn-destructive:hover { background: rgb(225 29 72); box-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(244, 63, 94, 0.3); } .ds-btn-destructive:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgb(5 5 14), 0 0 0 4px rgb(244 63 94); } .ds-btn-destructive:active { transform: scale(0.97); }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Terminal-style field: void ground, hairline border, plasma focus ring.
components.css: .ds-input-wrap { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; font-family: 'Syne', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-input-label { font-family: 'Space Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.75rem; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: rgb(144 144 160); } .ds-input { background: rgb(18 18 32); color: rgb(224 224 229); border: 1px solid rgb(37 37 53); border-radius: 0.25rem; height: 40px; padding: 0 12px; font-size: 0.875rem; transition: border-color 150ms, box-shadow 150ms; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: rgb(96 96 117); } .ds-input:hover { border-color: rgb(58 58 74); } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: rgb(26 127 255); box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(26, 127, 255, 0.25); }

components.name: Card
components.description: Base surface for every panel: one tonal step above the ground with a hairline border.
components.html:
SESSION
Telethon StringSession · verified
CardHeader / CardContent compose inside; pass padding="none".
components.css: .ds-card { background: rgb(18 18 32); border: 1px solid rgb(37 37 53); border-radius: 0.25rem; padding: 24px; box-shadow: 0 4px 30px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5); font-family: 'Syne', system-ui, sans-serif; color: rgb(224 224 229); } .ds-card-title { font-family: 'Space Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.75rem; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: rgb(144 144 160); margin-bottom: 4px; } .ds-card-desc { font-size: 0.8125rem; color: rgb(144 144 160); } .ds-card-body { font-size: 0.875rem; margin-top: 12px; line-height: 1.6; }

components.name: Status Chip
components.description: Semantic status badge — success/destructive/warning/muted only, mono uppercase label.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; font-family: 'Space Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.6875rem; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; padding: 3px 8px; border-radius: 0.125rem; border: 1px solid; } .ds-chip-dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 9999px; background: currentColor; } .ds-chip-running { color: rgb(0 224 112); background: rgba(0, 224, 112, 0.1); border-color: rgba(0, 224, 112, 0.35); } .ds-chip-running .ds-chip-dot { animation: ds-chip-pulse 2s ease-in-out infinite; } .ds-chip-failed { color: rgb(244 63 94); background: rgba(244, 63, 94, 0.1); border-color: rgba(244, 63, 94, 0.35); } .ds-chip-idle { color: rgb(245 158 11); background: rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.1); border-color: rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.35); } @keyframes ds-chip-pulse { 0%, 100% { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1); } 50% { opacity: 0.7; transform: scale(1.1); } }

components.name: Side Nav Item
components.description: Rail navigation item; active state is a plasma left accent plus accent text.
components.html: AgentsDashboardActivity
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; background: rgb(10 10 22); border-right: 1px solid rgb(37 37 53); padding: 12px 8px; width: 272px; } .ds-nav-item { display: block; font-family: 'Syne', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; color: rgb(144 144 160); text-decoration: none; padding: 9px 12px; border-radius: 0.25rem; border-left: 2px solid transparent; transition: background 150ms, color 150ms, border-color 150ms; } .ds-nav-item:hover { background: rgb(26 26 40); color: rgb(224 224 229); } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgb(5 5 14), 0 0 0 4px rgb(26 127 255); } .ds-nav-active, .ds-nav-active:hover { color: rgb(112 184 255); background: rgba(26, 127, 255, 0.1); border-left-color: rgb(26 127 255); }

narrative.overview: Mimic42 is a control console for AI Telegram agents, so the interface behaves like a piece of operator hardware: a near-black indigo ground with a faint blueprint grid, sharp corners, monospace telemetry, and light that only appears when something means something. shadcn/ui is the component vocabulary; its semantic tokens are mapped over the void/plasma/neon/crimson palette, so the app reads as one dark world with a component library inside it — never a generic shadcn template and never a light theme. Density is deliberate: quiet surfaces, hairline borders, color reserved for state and action. Glow is a reward, not decoration — plasma for action/active, neon for running/OK, crimson for destruction/failure, amber for idle/warning.
keyCharacteristics: Dark ground, sharp corners (radius 0.25rem), 40x40 blueprint grid + scan-line texture
Syne for voice/headings, Space Mono for data/labels/IDs/timestamps
Bright accent fills with dark void-950 foregrounds — WCAG AA on every filled control
Status color is semantic and exclusive: success / destructive / warning / muted
Icons are lucide-react only; Telegram secrets never render

rules.name: The Dark Ground Rule
rules.body: No light surface, ever. New components take their ground from --background/--card, never a hex of their own.

rules.name: The State-Only Rule
rules.body: plasma/neon/crimson/amber mean action or state. Decoration borrows border, muted, and opacity — never an accent hue.

rules.name: The One H1 Rule
rules.body: Exactly one h1 per rendered page state; use CardTitle as="h1" for a page's main title.

rules.name: The Glow-Is-State Rule
rules.body: Glow appears only for interaction or status; at rest a surface is flat and matte.

dos: Do take ground, border, text, and status color from semantic tokens (bg-card, border-border, text-muted-foreground, text-success/text-destructive).
Do keep one h1 per page state and reserve Space Mono for machine-like text.
Do pass padding="none" when a Card wraps its own header/content sub-components.
donts: Don't introduce a light surface, a foreign hue, or emoji/unicode glyphs as controls (use lucide-react).
Don't render Telegram secrets (api_hash, phone_code_hash, session strings).
Don't pad a Card that already wraps its own header/content sub-components.
